auth.peer.evidence: Against a live sshd reading the hub's enrolment files (transports/ssh/test/FarEnd.ps1, run by test/test-transport-conformance.ps1, remote plan R17c-3): an enrolled key with the hub's host key pinned connects; a key never enrolled, a hub whose host key is not the pinned one, and a revoked key whose line was put back by hand are each refused. Argv pins the host key (StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, HostKeyAlias=horde-hub-<hubId>, Horde's own known_hosts only) and offers only Horde's key, as ssh.exe -G reports in transports/ssh/test/test-ssh.ps1.

encrypt.evidence: ssh encrypts the session by design, but no session to a live sshd has been run here (remote plan R16).

dial.out.evidence: A node-role Open through the port dials a live sshd, the hub's listener as R17a runs it, and frames round-trip through the enrolled key's forced command (transports/ssh/test/FarEnd.ps1, run by test/test-transport-conformance.ps1, remote plan R17c-3).

dial.in.evidence: The hub never dials a node (remote design 1.2, founder decision 1): nodes dial out, and only the hub runs sshd.

accept.evidence: The accepting end is the hub's sshd with a forced command, run by horde listen (remote plan R16), not this process; the adapter's Listen refuses naming R16.

keepalive.evidence: Argv sets ServerAliveInterval=15 and ServerAliveCountMax=4, as ssh.exe -G reports; a dead hub noticed without a frame has not been shown against a live sshd (remote plan R16).

survives.peer.restart.evidence: An ssh session ends when sshd restarts; a new link must be opened (remote design 2.1).
